## IsReadOnly {#Sisk_Core_Http_ListeningHostRepository_IsReadOnly}

Gets an boolean indicating if this [ListeningHostRepository](https://docs.sisk-framework.org/api/Sisk.Core.Http.ListeningHostRepository.md) is read only. This property always returns [`false`](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/csharp/language-reference/builtin-types/bool).

```csharp
public bool IsReadOnly { get; }
```

[bool](https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.boolean)
